summary: Added strict version-1 app preference sidecar codec for all FerbyAppPreferences fields, including nested legacy AppSettings. Validates exact fields, enum strings, booleans, zoom and JPEG ranges, rejects unknown schemas/fields, enforces 16,384-byte UTF-8 limit, and returns immutable owned values. Added exports and README documenting Ferby defaults and persistence seam.
